about: Water names in Oklahoma's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for OK: the waters of the National Park Service's sampling places at Chickasaw National Recreation Area (its table read 2026-11-14, places tied to waters by the park's own description), one row per name and county, with the GNIS points of the named places. No record is open on them today (no result reached the park's threshold); they are listed so a later result is placed. EPA's overflow tables hold no Oklahoma report, and every receiving water of Oklahoma's permits is already on the national list.
